**[FACT]** plain. **[JUDGMENT, high confidence]** qualified. **[FACT + JUDGMENT]** compound.

[UNCERTAIN: vendor-stated foreign price] colon form. [FACT: vendor-stated specification; UNCERTAIN price] mixed.

**[HYPE/DEMO]-adjacent preprint** and **[STALE-BUT-FOUNDATIONAL]** in bold; **[JUDGMENT] Use one baseline, then freeze:** the chip replaces only the bracket.

[FACT for final records; UNCERTAIN for author-reported abstract numbers] long compound.

Not labels: [Drone Rules, 2021 text](https://example.org/rules) and [FACT](https://example.org/x) and [NOTE] and [fact].

| Label | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **[FACT]** | Directly checkable. |
| **[JUDGMENT]** | A recommendation. |
| **[UNCERTAIN]** | Partial evidence. |
| **[HYPE/DEMO]** | Promotional. |
| **[STALE-BUT-FOUNDATIONAL]** | Aged examples. |
